documentation.content:
QUEUE_AGE_EXCEEDED or SWEEP_TRUNCATED was logged by bharat-sourcer-integration: queued work is older than expected or the scheduled sweep hit its limit. See docs/contracts/queued-dispatch.md.

Runbook: [backend/infra/runbooks.md#queue-stuck](https://github.com/Dawn-Of-Justice/bharat-sourcer/blob/main/backend/infra/runbooks.md#queue-stuck)

Specs: backend/infra/monitoring/, guide: backend/infra/monitoring.md

conditions.displayName: Queue age exceeded or sweep truncated

conditionMatchedLog.filter: resource.type="cloud_run_revision" AND resource.labels.service_name="bharat-sourcer-integration" AND (textPayload:"QUEUE_AGE_EXCEEDED" OR textPayload:"SWEEP_TRUNCATED" OR jsonPayload.message:"QUEUE_AGE_EXCEEDED" OR jsonPayload.message:"SWEEP_TRUNCATED")
